title: i18n(service-storage): ship the file and upload-session objects in all eleven platform languages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBxjikPH2bUin9o95gbAxsx)_


domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU

Refs #30512 — package 10 of 11 (`@objectstack/service-storage`), moved ahead in the order by the seat now that #30335's storage half (#30627) has merged. The card stays open: the last PR of the series flips the bundle check to the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 文件与上传会话两个对象（`sys_file`、`sys_upload_session`）的名称、字段、选项、帮助和视图名补上 7 种语言：繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡、俄语、德语、韩语，与平台语言表的 11 种一致。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表（#29428 裁决 F）要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 10 个包（68 条），按席位安排插队。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；原有 4 种一字未改；已包含 #30627 合入后的全部键。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前），再抽看 `ar.objects.generated.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=storage` 输出 in sync；`node scripts/check-i18n-stale-fill.mjs` 退出 0。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Seven new locales for the storage objects under the platform locale table's tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 68 leaves plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes`, served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing three. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the seven tags and its merge baseline imports the seven bundles, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked per leaf against `en`. Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers in Latin script.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose:** the HTTP header name `ETag` in every locale; `Bucket` (the object-storage term the providers' own pt-BR and de documentation use) and `Status` (a native word) in `pt-BR` and `de`. The extractor records each as a source copy.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
